newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian Treasury pleased with recent market gains.
newsitem.headline: Italian Treasury pleased with recent market gains.

text.p: The Treasury said on Monday it was pleased with the recent performance of the Italian markets, saying it showed investors had confidence in the economy.
The Milan stock market has rose nearly 10 percent over the last three days while Italian bond futures closed at record highs on Monday.

"This shows (the markets) have faith in the health of the Italian economy and the possibility of growth," the Treasury said in a statement, adding that people backed what the government was doing to overhaul state accounts.
Bond dealers said on Monday that euphoria had swept the market amid expectations that the government will have little difficulty pushing through a supplementary budget sooner rather than later.
Hopes of a breakthrough in the near future in stalled negotiations between engineering and metal workers' unions and their employers also gave the market a lift. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
